<<Airing Out A Boathouse, Briefly>>  
The boathouse was sealed off for maintenance, but the neighborhood rallied to air it out. Volunteers cleared the space, ensuring all trestles were stable. The trestles supported the boat and equipment, keeping the area safe. After a thorough cleaning, the trestles were inspected for wear, and the boathouse was ready for use. The community came together, showing support and care for their shared space.
